anomalies.description: A construction vehicle (excavator/backhoe) is seen tipping over onto its side while moving across the road, resulting in a crash. The vehicle loses stability and falls between frames f0 and f7.

The red car ahead suddenly decelerates and swerves left, colliding with the black van in the adjacent lane; both vehicles come to an abrupt stop with visible rear-end contact and brake lights fully illuminated.; A red SUV is struck on its left side by a dark van that swerves across the lane from the left, causing a collision on a multi-lane highway during low-light conditions. The impact occurs around 57.5–58.0 seconds and results in the SUV being pushed sideways while the van continues forward slightly before coming to rest adjacent to the SUV.
A white SUV abruptly enters the lane from the right side and cuts sharply in front of the dashcam vehicle, causing a near-collision; debris is visible on the road immediately after the maneuver.
